_what: What the message box tells the sender before a message goes to someone outside their working hours, or to someone who is not in the pursuit (src/workspace/quiet-send-check.ts). The modes a person chooses for what happens when someone writes to them then are the rows of parts/timed-action/do-work/quiet-hours.json. `{names}` is the people's names, `{when}` the time they next work, in the sender's own zone.
quiet: {names} is outside working hours until {when}. Send again to send it anyway.
quiet_many: {names} are outside working hours; the first back is at {when}. Send again to send it anyway.
away: {names} is not in this pursuit and will not see this. Send again to send it anyway.
away_many: {names} are not in this pursuit and will not see this. Send again to send it anyway.
